beats.headline: Cultivating on a box truck
beats.text: Enemy intelligence, the eve of the Chowder War. The land crabs have massed in the south to sneak-attack the monk seals, and one of them sits on top of a crashed box truck, glowing faintly yellow and talking to himself. Raul, level 70. Years of cultivation have brought him to the verge of a breakthrough, which he prays to reach before the battle begins. Probably not, notes the description, if his meditations keep getting interrupted. Crawler Carl wants one of these crabs for the deck. He picks this one.

beats.headline: A crab trap with a roll-up door
beats.text: Raul has not sensed anyone. He is rehearsing threats for the seals. Crawler Donut casts Hole under him, drops him into the truck's empty cargo bay and mutes him; Crawler Carl phases through the floor and walls on a potion, punching, while Donut dangles from the door rope with free weights through her tail and the door stays stuck half open. Under a Fear smoke curtain and Brain Freeze the crab cowers, claws up, saying no. Carl flags him on a second potion. The card is common. Carl has doubts.

beats.headline: This worthless maggot begs
beats.text: Training record. Raul casts Bris, which snaps things from a distance, and a shell that takes ten seconds of chanting. He fights well and submits to everybody. Paying Donut a compliment, he calls anyone blind to her brilliance blind to her vastness; asked whether that means fat, he throws himself down and begs permission to kill himself in his dishonour. With Geraldo it is insults, then blows over a remark about Raul's mother. Donut says stop. Raul, who is winning, stops. Geraldo cracks his shell and kills him.

beats.headline: Greased Lightning on a ghost
beats.text: Deckmaster fight on the road to Key West. A level-65 Reef Explorer in a glowing deep-dive suit is a ghost, and only magic hurts him. Donut summons Raul, who bows, sits, chants, and sets off after the fleeing creature with a glowing claw. Lazarus calls him a pansy for taking too long; Donut throws him a Greased Lightning instead of sending in the bazooka, to build his self-confidence. The speeded crab snaps the ghost's leg off, and the suit deflates. Donut reports that Raul and Geraldo are finally tolerating each other.

beats.headline: This insignificant cur is here
beats.text: Crawler Carl is blind, pierced and caught in a bear hug by Sharp-Elbows, an ogre necromancer and deckmaster nine of ten, in a collapsing barn full of turkeys. Master Carl, comes the cry, this insignificant cur is here to rescue you. Raul snaps her necro staff in half, killing her last totem, and a Heal gives Carl his sight back. The ogre's eyes are right there, pleading. Raul snaps again and takes her head, and tumbles away in a rain of turkeys.

beats.headline: The holy discharge
beats.text: A many-headed card boss, and Crawler Carl is on fire. Raul arrives calling him Daddy Carl, promises to quench the demon fire with his holy discharge, and sprays water into Carl's face, and keeps spraying after the fire is out. Alpha Carl, fighting for the boss, announces that he is the crab's daddy now. Raul calls him a demon unworthy of respect. Alpha Carl says something about Raul's mother. Crack. Totem eliminated.

beats.headline: Ascending, under pressure
beats.text: The demon Amayon needs millions of souls to go home, and the AI has ruled that crab sperm counts. On a beach of corpses, Crawler Carl summons Raul, tells him his people are dead, that he is the last one, and that he must fertilise the eggs now. Raul objects to the pressure, asks Carl not to watch, and requests a baby seal; there is a pile of dead ones. What finally works is Alpha Carl, summoned on Carl's side this time, yelling at him. Raul announces that he is ascending past the cloud rank. No more kowtowing.

beats.headline: Special mention to Crawler Carl
beats.text: Crawler Donut has already reported that Raul timed out back into her deck and is way stronger now. Then the announcement to all crawlers in Cuba: the eviction worked. The AI singles out Crawler Carl, who, it says, literally pulled off a guy named Raul to make it happen, and spells out the metaphor for anyone who missed it. Carl informs the ceiling that this is not true. Elle asks a follow-up question about the anatomy. Carl says the crab did it himself.

beats.headline: Mythic, and furious about it
beats.text: Crawler Carl and Lucia Mar go tumbling together, caked in oil, and Crawler Donut finally summons Raul. The level-up at the end of the previous floor took him from 70 to 110, his card is now mythic, and a summoning lasts ten minutes. His voice is deeper. He tears into Lucia's shield, asks how she dares challenge Daddy Carl, and for crimes against the heavens sentences her to eternal death. Please, Lucia says. Wait, says Carl.

beats.headline: Die, demon, die
beats.text: Daddy Carl is magnanimous today, Raul informs Lucia, who should now kiss his famed alabaster feet; then Carl sends him up the ramp to help Donut. Soon after, he comes back out of the tower in a heap with Carl, three Mongos and Gustavo the rottweiler, his shell sizzling from lightning and his health almost gone. He lunges to snap off the dog's head, shouting die, demon, die. The lightning takes him in the centre of the chest, and he disappears in a puff of smoke.

beats.headline: Could he be set free
beats.text: Tenth floor. Imani's fairy card Jacobus has come back as something real, and Crawler Donut did not know cards could be turned real. She almost says something else, and holds it back; Carl is thinking of Paz, whose card was ripped at the end of the eighth floor. What she asks instead: could they set Raul free forever? Crawler Carl doubts it. This was a god thing.
